NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION - LEVEL OF CARE, INPATIENT VERSUS OBSERVATION

This letter is to advise you that Cascade Mutual has completed a level of care review of the above service and has issued an adverse determination regarding the level of care billed. The requested inpatient level of care is not certified. Based on the information submitted for the stay from [[ADMIT_DATE]] to [[DISCHARGE_DATE]], the services provided could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

The clinical record was reviewed against the MCG-style guidelines applicable to this admission. The following guideline codes were not met:

COPD-01: Payer finding - oxygenation was near baseline and did not require inpatient care.

COPD-03: Payer finding - blood gas values did not show acute respiratory acidosis.

No other guideline codes were applied in this level of care determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

The following codes apply to this adverse determination:

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

This determination addresses the level of care only, inpatient versus observation. It is not a statement regarding the medical necessity of any other component of the member's care.

APPEAL RIGHTS

The member, or the provider acting as the member's authorized representative, may submit a written appeal of this level of care determination. Written appeals must be addressed to Utilization Management at the address shown on this notice.

To support review, each argument in the appeal should reference the applicable guideline code, COPD-01 or COPD-03, and respond to the specific payer finding stated above for that code. The appeal must include a physician attestation line signed by the treating or reviewing physician.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that time may not be eligible for reconsideration under the plan's utilization management procedures.

Additional clinical documentation relevant to the level of care rendered between [[ADMIT_DATE]] and [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] may be submitted with the written appeal.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
